        double eps = 1e-15;
        int x = sc.nextInt();
        int y = sc.nextInt();
        int nn = sc.nextInt();

        double a = (double) x / y;

        int n = x;
        int d = y;
        double ans = 1000000.0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= nn; i++) {
            double ii = ((double) x * i) / y;
            double l = Math.floor(ii);
            double h = Math.ceil(ii);
            double gg = l / i;
            double gh = h / i;
            double ll = Math.abs(gg - a);
            double hh = Math.abs(gh - a);

            if (Math.abs(hh - ll) < eps) {
                if (hh < ans - eps) {
                    n = (int) l;
                    d = i;
                    ans = hh;
                }
            } else if (hh < ll) {
                if (hh < ans - eps) {
                    n = (int) h;
                    d = i;
                    ans = hh;
                }
            } else {
                if (ll < ans - eps) {
                    n = (int) l;
                    d = i;
                    ans = ll;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(n + "/" + d);
        sc.close();
    }
}
